title: $5K bonus payments for trades workers going out early next month, government says
summary: Bonuses for Red Seal trades workers are set to be delivered starting early next month.

image.caption: A welder works on a bus at the Prevost Car plant in Sainte-Claire, Que., on Aug. 27, 2026. People who have completed apprenticeships in Red Seal trades are now eligible to apply for a $5,000 bonus from the government. (Jacques Boissinot/The Canadian Press)

blocks.text: Bonuses for Red Seal trades workers are set to be delivered starting early next month.
Jobs minister says more than 16,000 applications have been received
· Posted: Nov 24, 2026 11:23 AM EST | Last Updated: 9 minutes ago
Since last week, tradespeople who completed an apprenticeship and earned their certification in a Red Seal trade on or after April 1, 2025, have been able to apply for a $5,000 completion bonus.
Jobs Minister Patty Hajdu says more than 16,000 applications have been received and the first payments will go out to eligible people starting the first week of December.
Starting in July, "trade qualifiers" who haven't completed an apprenticeship but have enough practical work experience and are certified in a Red Seal trade can apply for the bonus as well.

items: These young people see bright future in trades but say stigma among obstacles in their way

blocks.text: Red Seal trades are skilled jobs with national standards, including for training, such as electricians, plumbers and welders.
The Liberals have announced billions of dollars in spending to train up to 100,000 new skilled workers over the next half decade to support the government's ambitious infrastructure agenda.
Catherine Morrison is a reporter for The Canadian Press.
